name: sweet-winking-girl-portrait
image_vibe: Friendly natural wink with casual youthful-adult styling and clean studio realism
image_purpose: Create a warm social-fashion portrait for editorial or profile visual use.

prompt.project_info: A hyper-realistic upper-body studio portrait of an original adult woman with a playful wink and peace-sign gesture.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with natural human facial proportions, a cute friendly expression, one eye winking, and a natural smile. She has dark-brown hair in a ponytail with straight bangs, a small light-colored scrunchie, and loose face-framing strands. She wears a fitted sleeveless tank top with thin straps and lace neckline detail, paired with casual short shorts.
prompt.composition_elements: Subject standing slightly angled toward camera with upper body visible, one hand raised in a casual peace sign, relaxed playful posture, clean light background with no environmental distractions, and clear focus on face, hair, and neckline detail.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even neutral lighting with balanced exposure and gentle shadows, natural skin sheen, friendly approachable studio mood, and modern editorial realism.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic portrait photography, 85mm lens, f/4, high-resolution detail, realistic hair, lace, fabric, and skin texture with visible pores, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic upper-body studio portrait of an original adult woman with natural human facial proportions, a cute friendly expression, one eye winking, and a natural smile. Style her dark-brown hair in a ponytail with straight bangs, a small light-colored scrunchie, and loose strands framing the face. Dress her in a fitted sleeveless tank top with thin straps and lace detail along the neckline, paired with casual short shorts. Stand her slightly angled toward camera with upper body visible and one hand raised in a casual peace-sign gesture. Use a clean light background with no environmental distractions, soft even neutral lighting, balanced exposure, gentle shadows, an 85mm lens at f/4, realistic skin texture and sheen, detailed hair, lace, and fabric, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, modern editorial realism, and no text or watermark.
